Merrimack County Board of Commissioners


Thank you for your interest in the Merrimack County Board of Commissioners. This page is intended to keep residents, stakeholders, and community partners informed about the work of the Board and its impact across the County.

Here, you will find summaries of key discussions, motions presented and voted on, as well as updates on current and future initiatives being considered. Our goal is to promote transparency, accountability, and engagement in County operations and decision-making.

Meeting Information and Materials

Meeting documents and resources are posted below and may include:

  • Public notices

  • Meeting agendas

  • Minutes of prior meetings

  • Video recordings of Board sessions

Materials are updated regularly in accordance with meeting schedules and statutory requirements.

Public Participation

Merrimack County welcomes public input at all Board of Commissioner meetings. Individuals wishing to speak during public comment periods are encouraged to review our Public Comment Policy, which outlines the appropriate procedures and expectations to ensure a respectful and productive forum.

To view the full Public Comment Policy, please click here.
